name: setPropertyString
syntax:
setPropertyString(filepath, key, value [, encoding])
setPropertyString(filepath, properties)
description: Sets one key, or several keys from a struct, in a Java properties file. Existing keys are updated, new keys are added, and other keys are kept. The file is rewritten with a `#File created by CF` comment and a timestamp at the top.

params.name: filepath
params.description: Absolute path to the properties file.

params.name: key
params.description: The key to set. Not used when passing a `properties` struct.

params.name: properties
params.description: A struct of keys and values to set. Pass it as the second argument instead of `key` and `value`.

coldfusion.notes: Listed by getFunctionList() in ColdFusion 2025+. No official documentation exists. Signature and behavior confirmed on CF2025.
